TEXT ORDER: The court was unable to contact plaintiff at the telephone number he provided for today's settlement conference. Plaintiff's failure to appear for future conferences, may result in the dismissal of his case. It is plaintiff's obligation to keep the court apprised of his current address and telephone number. If possible, he shall also provide an e-mail address to receive communications from the court. The settlement conference is rescheduled to January 30, 2009 at 10:00 a.m. before Hon. Jeremiah J. McCarthy. Plaintiff may participate via telephone and shall provide the court ((716) 362-9350) with a telephone number where he can be reached no later than 2 days prior to the settlement conference. The court will initiate the call. No later than 10 days before the conference, plaintiff shall serve defendants (copy to the Court) with a settlement statement and proposal. No later than 5 days before the conference, defendants shall serve plaintiff (copy to the Court) with a settlement statement and counter-proposal. The settlement statements shall detail your position and attach any supporting documentation. Each party shall also submit a confidential settlement statement to me no later than 2 days prior to the settlement conference. The confidential settlement statement is not to be exchanged with your opponent. It shall include your undisclosed settlement position and any other confidential information that may be helpful to settling the case. SO ORDERED. Issued by Hon. Jeremiah J. McCarthy on 1/8/09. (The Court has mailed a copy of this Order to Plaintiff).(DAZ) (Entered: 01/08/2009)

TEXT ORDER: In accordance with yesterday's telephonic status conference conducted in chambers, plaintiff advised the court that he failed to appear for yesterday's scheduled telephonic deposition 30 due to a work-related scheduling conflict. While that excuse is sufficient to avoid dismissal of the action at this time, plaintiff is hereby ordered to reimburse the New York State Attorney General's Office for the court reporter costs it incurred in connection with the scheduled deposition. Defendants' counsel shall provide plaintiff (copy to the court) with the court reporter's invoice, and plaintiff shall reimburse the Attorney General's Office for that amount within 30 days thereafter. Once the parties advise the court that plaintiff has reimbursed the Attorney General's Office, another telephonic deposition will be scheduled. Plaintiff's unexcused failure to reimburse the Attorney General's Office for its costs, or unexcused failure to appear for any further scheduled depositions, shall result in the dismissal of this case. SO ORDERED. Issued by Hon. Jeremiah J. McCarthy on 10/21/09. (Court has mailed a copy of this Order to Plaintiff).(DAZ) (Entered: 10/21/2009)
